full_prompt_en: A square documentary photograph shows an artist seated on an outdoor pavement beside a large chalk drawing that stretches away into the upper left distance. The artist, wearing a dark short-sleeved shirt and light trousers, leans forward at the right edge and touches a narrow drawing tool to the pavement. Several sticks of colored chalk lie nearby. The artwork spreads across many paving slabs as a luminous landscape: deep purple and blue ground, a dark branching tree rising from the lower left, bright amber sunset discs near the horizon, and long bands of coral, turquoise, and gold reflected in water. The chalk colors are blended and layered but remain powdery, with granular pavement texture showing through. The perspective of the photograph lets the artwork recede along the walkway, making its painted horizon appear far away while the artist remains large in the near right foreground. Soft late-day light falls on the real pavement and the artist, whereas the chalk scene itself seems internally radiant because of its high-contrast warm highlights. The outer street and a few distant urban shapes are blurred and secondary. The drawn tree trunk anchors the lower left, guiding the eye toward the glowing center. Smudged edges, loose dust, and uneven slab seams make clear that the image is temporary and handmade. There is no readable text or caption on the pavement. The mood is absorbed and fleeting, capturing the physical act of making a vivid imaginary sunset directly on ordinary ground.
full_prompt_zh: 一张方形纪实照片拍到一位画家坐在户外人行道旁，身侧大型粉笔画延伸向左上远处。画家穿深色短袖和浅色裤，前倾在右缘，用细绘画工具触碰地面。几根彩色粉笔躺在旁边。画作跨过许多铺路板，呈发亮风景：深紫与蓝地面、一棵从左下升起的深色分叉树、地平线附近明亮琥珀日落圆盘，以及水中珊瑚、青绿与金色的长反射带。粉笔颜色相互揉合叠加，却仍有粉末感，颗粒路面肌理从中露出。照片透视让画作沿人行道后退，使画中地平线似乎很远，而画家在右前景保持大尺度。柔和傍晚光落在真实地面和画家身上，粉笔画自身则因高对比暖高光仿佛从内部发亮。外侧街道及少量远处城市形模糊且次要。画出的树干稳定左下，把视线带往明亮中心。涂抹边缘、松散粉尘与不平砖缝清楚表明图像短暂且手作。地面没有可读文字或说明。氛围专注而易逝，捕捉在普通地面上直接创作鲜明想象日落的实体动作。
style_prompt_en: Use a tactile chalk-drawing treatment on a coarse dark surface. Layer powdery marks and finger-smudged transitions so vivid cyan, violet, coral, amber, and gold glow against charcoal and deep blue. Let grain, seams, dust, and irregular edges remain visible through the image. Build a clear luminous focal area with broad rubbed color bands, then use narrow darker strokes for directional structure. A low oblique viewpoint can turn the working surface into a receding field. Preserve the sense of temporary hand labor: color is rich but visibly particulate, never glossy or digitally smooth. The mood is intimate, inventive, and fleeting, with warm highlights seeming to shine from a rough material ground.
style_prompt_zh: 在粗糙深色表面上采用可触的粉笔画处理。层叠粉末痕迹和手指揉抹过渡，使鲜艳青、紫、珊瑚、琥珀与金色从炭黑和深蓝中发光。让颗粒、接缝、粉尘与不规则边缘穿过画面保持可见。以宽阔擦抹色带建立清楚发亮焦点，再用狭窄深色线条组织方向结构。低斜视角可使工作表面成为后退的场。保留短暂手工劳动感：颜色丰厚却明显由微粒组成，绝不光滑或数码化。氛围亲近、有创造力且易逝，暖亮部似乎从粗糙材料底上发光。
theme_en: An artist drawing a glowing sunset landscape in chalk on the pavement
theme_zh: 画家在人行道上用粉笔绘制发亮的日落风景
name: Chalk drawing
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
